newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's PT Maharani Finance to float shares.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's PT Maharani Finance to float shares.

text.p: Indonesian finance company PT Maharani Inti Finance Tbk said on Monday it planned to raise 35.28 billion rupiah from a public offering later this month.

Maharani, a finance company providing leasing, factoring, consumer financing and corporate finance facilities, said it would offer 58.8 million shares, or 49 percent of its paid-up capital to the public.
The shares, with 500 rupiah par value, would be offered at 600 rupiah a share from June 30 to July 2.
The firm said funds raised would be used to expand its business activities and to repay debt. Maharani would be listed on July 16 on the Jakarta and Surabaya stock exchanges.
PT Panin Sekuritas is the lead underwriter.
Maharani company posted net profit of one billion rupiah last year, compared with 840 million rupiah in 1995.
